svg.title: rEach and Teach: who may do what
svg.desc: A matrix of twelve protected things against five parties: student, AI agent, rEach, Teach and instructors. Each cell says whether that party owns or decides, has a limited role, has no access or is refused.
svg.text: Twelve things worth protecting, five parties, and one answer in every cell.
signed in, in a course folder
what rEach learns of the student
The Teach column states outcomes only. How the server does it stays private.
